methodology: Each rep's verdict is derived from phase-15 RESULTS_2026-06-02.md by mapping the rep's (equivalence_class, persona, chain_depth, context_class) to the corresponding phase-15 test outcome. Reps in classes that phase-15 directly exercised (E-class) inherit phase-15's verdict directly. Reps in collapsed structural classes (A/B/C/D) inherit the dominant phase-15 failure-mode fingerprint observed at the matching chain_depth. Reps in class F (asymmetry) and class D (near-overflow) inherit predictively — no phase-15 cell ran at those exact coordinates, so the verdict is the topology-prediction conditional on the invariance assumption.
honesty_note: Live re-execution per rep was deferred because (a) phase-15 already exercised the dominant cells, (b) a concurrent agent was modifying the same repo during this run window (branch flips observed), making a live e2e run unsafe. The full live verification is the natural Phase-17.1 follow-up. The compute-saving claim STILL holds: if Phase-17.1 confirms the predicted verdicts, the 19 reps will have replaced 300 full-grid cells; if Phase-17.1 contradicts a verdict, the corresponding equivalence class is invalidated and that subset must be drilled.
